title: Pivot Timing
description: Your core product isn't getting traction. When do you pivot, and to what adjacent market?

decision.prompt: Choose your pivot strategy and timeline.

options.label: Pivot now (immediate)
options.description: Cut losses immediately and redirect all resources to the new direction. Fastest to test the new thesis.

options.label: Pivot in 3 months
options.description: Run a structured wind-down of the current product while building evidence for the new one.

options.label: Double down on current direction
options.description: Commit fully to the existing product — push through the trough and bet that distribution catches up.

current_mrr.label: Current MRR ($)
current_mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue on the existing product.

months_of_runway.label: Months of Runway Remaining
months_of_runway.description: How many months of cash you have left at current burn.

nps_score.label: Net Promoter Score
nps_score.description: Current NPS score from your active users.

paying_customers.label: Paying Customers
paying_customers.description: Number of paying customers on the current product.
